parameters.name: DBInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The resource group ID. You can call theDescribeDBInstanceAttribute operation to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: SQLCollectorStatus
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the SQL Explorer (SQL Audit) feature. Valid values:

*   **Enable**
*   **Disabled**

example.unifiedCli: aliyun rds modify-sql-collector-policy --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk50000 --sql-collector-status Enable --resource-group-id rg-acfmx0000 --region cn-hangzhou
